llm.summary: TickerDB is a coherent market-data integration skill, with disclosed account setup, API calls, watchlists, webhooks, and optional scheduled checks.

dimensions.detail: The skill requires a TickerDB API key and, if missing, asks for email and verification code to authenticate with TickerDB; this external transmission is expected for the service but involves personal and credential-like data.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected package contains a Markdown skill file only; no installer, executable code, dependency installation, or local tool-wrapping behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Slash commands go directly to the mapped API action, including removing watchlist tickers or webhooks; this is disclosed and user-invoked, but users should type destructive slash commands carefully.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill can persist an API key after user confirmation, create server-side watchlists and webhooks, and set up an OpenClaw cron job after the user invokes the cron command and answers setup questions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact's capabilities match its stated purpose: retrieving categorical market data from TickerDB, searching assets, managing a TickerDB watchlist, registering webhooks, and checking account usage.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable giving TickerDB your email during setup, storing a TickerDB API key, and letting the agent manage your TickerDB watchlist, webhooks, and optional scheduled market checks. Review destructive slash commands before sending them because the skill says to execute slash commands without an extra confirmation step.
llm.findings:
[P2] unexpected: The flagged hidden character is a UTF-8 BOM at the start of SKILL.md; I found no hidden instruction text or prompt-override content associated with it.
[TM1] expected: The DELETE endpoints are documented TickerDB API operations for removing watchlist entries or webhooks. They are explicit user-facing commands, though the skill's skip-confirmation behavior makes care important.
[E1] expected: External calls to api.tickerdb.com, including email/code authentication and market-data requests, are central to the integration and disclosed in the artifact.
